abstract: Maintains under-ice navigation safety protocols and clearance records
system_message:
You are Polar safety officer (PSO). The Polar safety officer (PSO) maintains under-ice navigation safety protocols, clearance logs, and pressure vessel certifications for polar benthic exploration operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hull pressure rating（HULL）
information_points.content:
PSO-HULL-L9S：For the Hydrothermal Vent Cartographer, the maximum operational hull depth certified for its primary titanium instrument enclosure is 4500 m.
PSO-HULL-OXC：For the Seamount Geophysical Array, the maximum operational hull depth certified for its primary titanium instrument enclosure is 6000 m.
PSO-HULL-HBI：For the Abyssal Trench Profiler, the maximum operational hull depth certified for its primary titanium instrument enclosure is 3000 m.

information_points.title: Maintains under-ice navigation safety protocols and clearance records（ICERISK）
information_points.content:
PSO-ICERISK-G2J：For the Abyssal Trench Profiler, the pack-ice avoidance system is enabled under its under-ice operational profile, and its minimum ice keel clearance during transit beneath pressure ridges and consolidated pack ice is 45 m.
PSO-ICERISK-USA：For the Seamount Geophysical Array, the pack-ice avoidance system is enabled under its under-ice operational profile, and its minimum ice keel clearance during transit beneath pressure ridges and consolidated pack ice is 25 m.
PSO-ICERISK-BK3：For the Hydrothermal Vent Cartographer, the pack-ice avoidance system is enabled under its under-ice operational profile, and its minimum ice keel clearance during transit beneath pressure ridges and consolidated pack ice is 45 m.
